title: Plane Carrying DR Congo Military Delegation Crashes
detail: A plane carrying a DR Congo military delegation crashed on September 27, 2026. Details on casualties and the circumstances of the incident are still emerging. The crash represents a significant loss for the FARDC command structure amid ongoing operations in eastern DRC against AFC/M23-RDF and other armed groups.

media.caption: Plane carrying DR Congo military delegation crashes, Sept 27, 2026

confidenceReason: Breaking report from Al Jazeera (tier 1); details on casualties and exact location remain unconfirmed as of initial reporting.
